findings.claim: EHC 2026 Q3 net operating revenue $1,609.5M, +8.9% YoY; discharges 69,605, +5.7% (same-store +3.0%); net patient revenue per discharge +4.0% to $22,543.
findings.source: Encompass Health Q3 2026 earnings release (Q4 CDN PDF)
findings.excerpt: Third-quarter discharges totaled 69,605, up 5.7%, and same-store discharge growth was 3.0%.

findings.claim: CMS FY2027 IRF PPS final rule (effective 2026-10-01): 2.3% net update (3.2% market basket less 0.9pp productivity); est. +$755M aggregate vs FY2026; rural adjustment phase-out completes.
findings.source: CMS fact sheet FY 2027 IRF PPS final rule (CMS-1845-F)

findings.claim: Management says IRF demand remains strong; plans 250 beds via five new hospitals plus 100-150 beds at existing hospitals; NC certificate-of-need repeal effective Oct 1 could support 6-10 new facilities annually from 2029; Medicare-age population growing ~4% annually.
findings.source: MarketBeat, Encompass Health Q2 earnings call highlights

findings.claim: Q3 2026 results: Adjusted EBITDA +15.5% to $346.6M; full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $6.23-$6.37.
findings.excerpt: $6.23 to $6.37 For considerations regarding the Company's 2026 guidance, see the supplemental information posted on the Company's website at http://investor.encompasshealth.com.

note: Only one segment (IRF/Encompass Health inpatient rehab). Company market share data and an IRF-specific TAM forecast not found; adjacent medical rehab services market vendor estimates ~6% CAGR, definitions differ so not comparable. 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
